findings.summary: crates/server/src/linear.rs:85: no test covers the comment's time getting from Linear onto the gate. The fixture crates/server/tests/fixtures/linear_board.json:4 has no createdAt on any comment, and the github.rs tests call gates::from_comment(body, Some(..)) directly, so dropping the query field or the key would leave every comment gate at at: None and no test would fail.
findings.reason: The fixture's TRU-7 comments now carry createdAt, with Build round 2 posted after a failed Verify round 1; tests/linear.rs asserts the card shows Build 2 and its time. With the createdAt read replaced by None, that test fails.

findings.summary: crates/server/src/github.rs:218-219: each PR now costs one file read per stage that has records, not one in total. Without GITHUB_TOKEN the first read after a start can go past the 45-request cap with many tied PRs, so it takes several spaced reads before every card has its gate; again after each restart or push.
findings.reason: Noted in docs/STATUS.md next to the 45-request budget.

findings.summary: crates/server/src/linear.rs:14: comments(first: 50) has no ordering; if Linear gave the oldest 50 first, a ticket with more than 50 comments would show a stale gate.
findings.reason: Checked against real Linear: comments come newest first (TRU-10's first three are 07:10, 07:06, 06:58). The query now asks for orderBy: createdAt explicitly, with a comment saying why.

findings.summary: crates/server/src/github.rs:221: a record without recorded_at becomes a Gate with at: None, which sorts below every timed gate, and nothing is logged.
findings.reason: A warn is logged naming the file.
